REP: Hey Karen, this is Jordan with Apex Home Buyers — I saw your text come through earlier about the property on Elm. You got a couple minutes?
SELLER: Yeah, I do. I've been getting a lot of calls but yours was the first one that actually felt human, so go ahead.
REP: I appreciate that. So just to make sure I have this right — you own the place on Elm outright, you've been thinking about selling, and you wanted somebody who could close fast without a bunch of back-and-forth. Is that the picture?
SELLER: That's it. My husband passed last year and I just don't want to deal with the house anymore. There's some work it needs and I don't have it in me.
REP: Karen, I'm sorry to hear that. Can I ask what's been the hardest part of being there?
SELLER: Honestly, the upkeep. The roof leaks in the back bedroom and I just close the door. It's not how I want to live.
REP: Yeah, I hear you. So if I could take that off your plate — buy it as-is, no repairs, no agent commissions, you pick the closing date — what would that mean for you?
SELLER: It would mean I could move closer to my daughter in Tampa.
REP: That's the goal then. Let me ask — are you thinking weeks or months on the timeline? Because I can move as fast as you want.
SELLER: I'd like to be out before the school year starts. So a couple months I guess.
REP: Got it. And just so I can put a real number on this for you, do you have a sense of what you'd want to walk away with?
SELLER: I was thinking around 200, but I know it's not perfect.
REP: Okay. Most properties in your zip in similar shape have been trading between 165 and 185 cash, fast close. I want to be honest with you so I'm not wasting your time. Where I think we'd land is in that range. Would something in the high 170s be a conversation worth having?
SELLER: Maybe. I'd want to think about it.
REP: Totally fair. What specifically do you want to think through? Price? Timing? Or just the whole idea?
SELLER: Mostly the price. I figured I'd get more.
REP: I get it. Here's what I'd suggest — let me come look at it Wednesday morning so I can give you the most accurate number. If it's better than what I'm saying, I'll tell you. If it's not, you'll know exactly where you stand. Wednesday at 10 work?
SELLER: That works.
REP: Perfect. I'll send a confirmation text. And Karen — thank you for trusting me to take a look.
SELLER: Thank you Jordan.
